explanation: The official HCCI publication metadata (Metadata_All_Samples.xlsx) contains 777 tabulated acquisition records ranging from index 1 to 830. A systematic file audit of the source archive ('HCCI Dataset .zip') reveals exactly 774 valid PNG image files in the Images/ directory. Micrographs corresponding to sample IDs 10 (5kV BSE), 20 (10kV SE), and 30 (20kV InLens) are absent from both Images/ and Masks/ in the author-distributed archive. No files were lost during extraction. Because the source archive itself omits these three micrographs, the Phase 1 manifest strictly records the 774 verified physical image files without fabricating dummy images or placeholder data, while documenting the three omitted samples for reproducibility and provenance.
